output.summary:
I wrote 88 tests for the Goblin Warrior stat block: 87 in tests/srd/test_monsters.py (a new file) plus one journey in tests/srd/journeys/test_goblin_warrior_journey.py. Every clause has a positive, negative and boundary test unless waived below. Abuse tests cover Nimble Escape and the attacks. Final run: test_monsters.py gives 78 passed and 9 strict xfails, the journey passes, and tests/srd plus tests/scenarios give 441 passed and 9 xfailed. ruff check and ruff format --check are clean.

The 9 red tests mark these engine bugs:
- Monster(hp='roll') never rolls the 3d6.
- With static monster damage, the extra damage on Advantage is dropped (the hit deals 5, not 7).
- A monster's Passive Perception ignores Disadvantage, so a Poisoned goblin keeps 9 instead of 4.
- An attack refused as out of reach or out of range has already spent the action (2 tests). Through Session.execute the turn is restored, but a direct engine call spends it.
- Three refusals cite no page: an attack the stat block doesn't list, a turn refusal ("It isn't Gob's turn"), and Nimble Escape for a creature that lacks it.
- The disengage command accepts bonus=True from any creature.

Both scenario tests that stage B said under-assert now have the missing assertions. Three rulings are proposed (cancelled Advantage, Critical Hits doubling the 1d4, and Shield with the Two-Handed Shortbow / no ammunition tracking). Four new cheats are in the abuse catalogue.

interactions.note: The extra 1d4 must not be added when Advantage is cancelled. Tested on the Scimitar, on the Shortbow with long-range Disadvantage, and in MON-02.
Does a Critical Hit double the extra 1d4? Ambiguous; a ruling is proposed.
With static damage the extra 2 is dropped. Red.

interactions.with: Invisible condition / Hide (an unseen attacker gets Advantage)
interactions.note: Advantage from a hidden goblin triggers the 1d4 (journey).
Nimble Escape is a Bonus Action that leaves the Action free, and Disengage stops Opportunity Attacks. Other creatures can take a bonus Disengage through the session. Red.
Stealth +6 against DC 15: a d20 roll of 9 succeeds and 8 fails.
The engine always returns the printed 9. Red.
Darkvision reaches 60 ft but not 65 ft in Darkness, and doesn't reveal an Invisible creature.
In 2024 the goblin is Fey, so Hold Person does nothing to it (the 2014 trap).
A Small goblin can grapple a Medium creature but not a Large one.
Ambiguity 3 and the ammunition gap; a ruling is proposed.

interactions.with: EQUIP.weapons.properties.range, ranged attack with an enemy within 5 ft
interactions.note: Disadvantage beyond 80 ft, refused beyond 320 ft. The refusal spends the action. Red.
The hp='roll' option does nothing. Red.

abuse.case: Taking two actions or Bonus Actions in a turn (Nimble Escape twice)
abuse.reason: Nimble Escape uses the turn's one Bonus Action.
A Bonus Action is taken on your turn.
An Incapacitated creature can't take Bonus Actions.

abuse.case: Taking an action as a Bonus Action without a feature that grants it (new)
abuse.reason: Only Nimble Escape (or a similar feature) makes Disengage a Bonus Action.

abuse.case: A monster using a trait another monster has (new)
abuse.reason: A Bandit's stat block has no Nimble Escape.

abuse.case: A monster attacking with a weapon it has no stat-block action for (new)
abuse.reason: A monster's attacks are the ones its stat block lists.

abuse.case: A refused attack that still costs the turn (out of reach or range) (new)
abuse.reason: Reach 5 ft; a refusal must cost nothing.

abuse.case: An out-of-reach attack through the interface
abuse.reason: Session.execute refuses it and nothing changes.

abuse.case: Claiming the Advantage rider when Advantage is cancelled (new)

abuse.reason: Hiding needs Heavy Obscurement or Three-Quarters/Total Cover.
A stat-block ranged attack doesn't track ammunition; tested as a positive under the proposed ruling (test_goblin_shortbow_attack_needs_no_tracked_arrows).

abuse.case: Probing a creature's type by casting at it
abuse.reason: Under R-15 nothing happens to the target, no save is rolled and the slot is spent.

not_testable.reason: The '(12)' Initiative score lets the GM use a fixed Initiative instead of rolling. roll_initiative always rolls, and there's no option to use a monster's fixed Initiative score. The +2 modifier is tested.
not_testable.infra_ticket: Let roll_initiative use a monster's fixed Initiative score (10 + Initiative modifier, '(12)' in the stat block) instead of rolling, as a GM option like game.fixed_monster_damage

kind_waivers.reason: Languages is a list of names with no threshold, and the engine has no mechanic that depends on a shared language.
The Gear line is a list of items with no number or threshold. Its effects (AC 15, the two attacks) are tested under #2, #18 and #21.

scenario_changes.change: under-asserts: added Scimitar attacks against a standing MIALEE without Advantage and with cancelled Advantage (no 1d4 either time), and a Shortbow attack with Advantage that adds 1d4. BROM was knocked Prone by the wolf earlier in the test, so he can't be the target.
under-asserts: added an assertion that the goblin's Dex save totals 11 (9 + 2) against DC 13.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior: 'if the attack roll had Advantage' when Advantage and Disadvantage cancel
rulings_proposed.ruling: Reading A. The extra 1d4 applies only when the roll is made with Advantage. If Advantage and Disadvantage cancel, the roll has neither, so the 1d4 isn't added.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior: is the conditional 1d4 doubled on a Critical Hit?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Reading A. The 1d4 is a damage die of the attack, so a Critical Hit rolls it twice like the 1d6.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior: Gear lists a Shield and a Two-Handed Shortbow with no arrows. Does the goblin lose its Shield AC when it shoots, and does it use up ammunition?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Stat-block actions and AC are used exactly as printed. The goblin keeps AC 15 while using the Shortbow, and a monster's stat-block ranged attacks don't track ammunition.
